HomeAssist_explainer.summary: GEMIS built HomeAssist a single system for burst-geyser and plumbing jobs. Homeowners report online or insurers log claims; the system assigns the nearest available plumber from a national panel; customers get SMS or WhatsApp updates; plumbers photograph each step to prove SANS compliance; warranties and insurer claims update automatically; and HomeAssist sees every job nationwide in one dashboard.
HomeAssist_explainer.transcript: A geyser bursts. The homeowner goes online and reports it in minutes. Or her insurer logs the claim for her. Either way, the job lands in one place: the system GEMIS built for HomeAssist. HomeAssist works with a national panel of plumbers. The system finds the next available plumber near the job, and assigns it automatically. The customer is kept informed every step of the way, by SMS or WhatsApp. No phoning around for updates. On site, the plumber uses the app to photograph the work, proving each step meets SANS standards. Behind the scenes, the system links directly to insurers and manufacturers, checking warranties and updating claims automatically. HomeAssist sees every job across the country in one place, from first report to sign-off. Fewer phone calls. Faster repairs. GEMIS and HomeAssist have worked side by side for more than ten years.

Sonke_explainer.summary: GEMIS built Sonke Gender Justice a monitoring and evaluation system. Facilitators capture sessions on an offline-capable mobile app; M&E officers check and approve each record so every number traces to a real activity; programme managers track progress against targets by country and programme; each role sees the view it needs; and donor reports build from already-verified data.
Sonke_explainer.transcript: Sonke Gender Justice works to end gender-based violence and reduce the spread of HIV, in 40 countries across Africa. Every day, teams run workshops, dialogues and outreach. But funders ask a hard question: what difference did it make? So GEMIS built Sonke a monitoring and evaluation system. In the field, facilitators capture each session on a mobile app. It works offline, and syncs when there's signal. Back in the office, M&E officers check and approve what comes in, so every number can be traced to a real activity. Programme managers see progress against targets by country and programme, as it happens. Each person sees what their role needs: country teams their country, leadership the whole picture. When reporting time comes, the figures are already there. Donor reports come together from data that has already been checked. Less time on paperwork. More time on the work that matters. Built by GEMIS.

Tores_debating_platform.summary: The University of Stellenbosch Business School asked GEMIS to build one web platform for Tore's Foundation's weekly debating programme (430+ learners, 24 Western Cape schools). Competitions are set up in minutes, results are captured as debates end with live league standings, coaches claim expenses and stipends from their phones, and the programme team approves matched claims and sends one payment batch to finance.
Tores_debating_platform.transcript: Every week, Tore's Foundation runs debating for more than 430 learners in 24 schools across the Western Cape. Behind every debate is a coach, a competition to run, and expenses and stipends to pay. On paper, that was slow for everyone. The University of Stellenbosch Business School asked GEMIS to build one web platform for the programme. Competitions are set up in minutes: schools, rounds, motions and judges. Results are captured as each debate ends, and the standings update straight away, right through to the year-end final. Coaches claim expenses and stipends in the same web app: pick the session, snap the receipt, submit. The programme team checks every claim against the sessions actually run, approves it, and sends one payment batch to finance. More time for debate. Less time on admin. Built by GEMIS.

WasteMart_explainer.summary: GEMIS built WasteMart a system that turns a single call into a handled job: quotes are priced automatically with standard terms attached, customers accept and pay through a secure link, operations are alerted the moment payment lands, planners assign truck and driver, drivers confirm collection with a scan, and managers and customers can track every order.
WasteMart_explainer.transcript: A business needs its waste removed. It should take one call. But behind that call sat a lot of manual work: building a quote, attaching the right terms, chasing payment, then remembering to tell operations. GEMIS built WasteMart a system that handles that for them. The sales team picks the service, and the quote is priced, with standard terms and conditions attached automatically. The customer receives the quote, accepts it, and gets a secure payment link straight away. No chasing, no waiting for proof of payment. The moment payment comes through, operations is alerted and the job goes onto the schedule. Planners assign the truck and driver, and the driver confirms the collection on the mobile app with a quick scan. Managers see every order from quote to collection in one place, and the customer can track it too. Less admin. Faster payment. Every job on time. And a system that has grown with WasteMart for more than ten years.

TransHex_explainer.summary: In 2017 GEMIS stabilised Trans Hex's in-house management information system at the Baken diamond mine, automated the daily SAP financial data import (scheduled, de-duplicated, logged, with failure emails), and built an integrated management report covering plant, mining, finance, security and HR: budget against actual for month and year to date, filterable by mine and period, exportable to Excel and PDF. Version two added weekly figures, forecasts, variances, live exchange rates and mine groups. A report that took weeks became available on demand.
TransHex_explainer.transcript: Trans Hex has mined diamonds for more than 50 years. In 2017, GEMIS worked with its Baken mine on the Lower Orange River. Management needed one clear view: plant, mining, finance, security and people. But that view was pieced together in Excel from several sources. It took weeks, and errors crept in. GEMIS first got the company's own information system running reliably, then automated the daily feed of financial data from SAP. It runs on schedule, skips duplicates, and emails the team if anything fails. Then GEMIS built the management report into the system itself: gravel treated, carats, fleet availability and cost per carat, for the month and the year to date. Filter by mine, period or date range, and export to Excel or PDF. Version two added weekly figures, forecasts, variances and live exchange rates, and brought other operations into the same view. A report that took weeks, now ready whenever it was needed. Built by GEMIS.

SBS_explainer.summary: GEMIS built SBS Waterproofing's website and helped run its Google campaigns from 2014. As enquiries outgrew off-the-shelf apps, GEMIS built SBS its own business system from 2015: enquiry capture and sales pipeline, SMS reference numbers, quotes accepted online, automatic deposit invoices linked to accounting, profit per job and stock reorder alerts. SBS has grown many times over and still runs on it. The system grew into GEMIS's ManaGEM product.
SBS_explainer.transcript: SBS Waterproofing keeps Cape Town's roofs and walls dry. In 2014, GEMIS built their website and helped run their Google campaigns. Enquiries started coming in faster than anyone could keep track of. Off-the-shelf apps didn't fit how SBS worked, so GEMIS built them a system of their own. Every enquiry is captured, and the customer gets an SMS with a reference number straight away. Every call, email and appointment is tracked, all the way to the sale. Quotes go out in a few clicks, customers accept online, and the deposit invoice follows automatically, straight into the accounting system. Every project shows whether it made money, and the system sends a reminder when stock needs reordering. More than ten years on, SBS has grown many times over, and still runs its business on it. And the system built for SBS grew into ManaGEM. GEMIS and SBS Waterproofing have worked side by side since 2014.

ManaGEM_explainer.summary: ManaGEM is GEMIS's business management platform, generalised from the system built for SBS Waterproofing. It covers enquiry capture and sales pipeline with SMS and email updates, quotes accepted online, automatic deposit invoices, project profit tracking, stock alerts, products, prices and staff records in one system. About a dozen companies run their day-to-day operations on it.
ManaGEM_explainer.transcript: Most growing businesses hit the same wall: enquiries, quotes, jobs and stock scattered everywhere. SBS Waterproofing hit that wall too, so GEMIS built them a system, designed from day one to work for other businesses as well. That system became ManaGEM. Capture every enquiry and follow it to the sale, with SMS and email updates for the customer. Quotes go out in a few clicks, customers accept online, and deposit invoices follow automatically. Track every project and see the profit on each job. Keep track of stock, and get an alert before you run out. Products, prices and staff records sit in the same system. Today, about a dozen companies run their day-to-day operations on ManaGEM. Less time on admin. More time growing the business. Built by GEMIS.
